rationale: Importer differential lab and DesignIR JSON fixes found while freezing the holdout panels: DesignIR JSON now writes floats as their shortest round-trip text instead of six significant digits (sub-pixel layout survives from 1000 px up; values still parse identically, and no committed artifact pins the serializer bytes); the lab maps native boxes through their lone rotate() transforms the way native lowering paints them, scrubs per-run backendNodeId values from the semantic snapshot digest, and gains a viewport flag, a holdout opt-in and a Pillow preflight; the script-test inputs are regenerated. Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
